title: Preliminary Qualitative Phytochemical Analysis
author: Matin Mahmood
materials: Two tests used for detection of flavonoids
Two tests used for identification of steroids

steps.title: Test for Alkaloids
steps.instruction: Detect alkaloids using Mayer's and Wagner's reagents after acid treatment.

substeps.instruction: Stir 2 ml of alcoholic extract and fractions with 5 ml of 1% HCl on a steam bath.
Add Mayer’s reagent (1.35 g mercuric chloride in 60 ml water + 5 g potassium iodide in 10 ml water); a white precipitate indicates alkaloids.
Add Wagner’s reagent (1.27 g iodine and 2 g potassium iodide in 100 ml water); a reddish brown precipitate indicates alkaloids.

steps.title: Lead Acetate Test for Flavonoids
steps.instruction: Test for flavonoids using lead acetate solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 10% lead acetate solution to 2 ml of alcoholic extract and fractions.
Observe for the formation of a yellowish-white precipitate.

steps.title: NaOH Test
steps.instruction: Treat extract with NaOH and HCl to check for yellow orange color.

substeps.instruction: Treat 2 ml of the extract and fractions with aqueous NaOH and HCl.
Observe for the formation of a yellow orange color.

steps.title: Liebermann-Burchard Test for Steroids
steps.instruction: Detect steroids using chloroform, acetic anhydride, and sulphuric acid.

substeps.instruction: Treat 2 ml of the extract and fractions with chloroform and acetic anhydride.
Observe for the formation of a dark pink or red color.

steps.title: H2SO4 Test for Steroids
steps.instruction: Detect steroids using sulphuric and acetic acids.

substeps.instruction: Treat 2 ml of the extract and fractions with sulphuric and acetic acids.
Observe for the development of a greenish color.

steps.title: Test for Terpenoids
steps.instruction: Detect terpenoids using chloroform and concentrated sulphuric acid with heat.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 2 ml of the organic extract and fractions in 2 ml of chloroform.
Add 2 ml of concentrated sulphuric acid.
